source.note: Inbound HTTP body is copied verbatim from the Go testdata file anthropic-simple-inbound.request.json (the same fixture used by TestInboundTransformer_TransformRequest_WithTestData case 'simple text request transformation'). The Go inbound unit test asserts the resulting llm.Request has Model='claude-3-sonnet-20240229', MaxTokens=1024, Temperature=0.7, Stop.MultipleStop=['Human:','Assistant:'], one user message with content 'Hello, Claude! How are you today?'. The outbound Go test (NewOutboundTransformer('https://api.anthropic.com','test-api-key')) asserts URL='https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', Content-Type='application/json', Anthropic-Version='2023-06-01', Auth.Type='api_key'. The outbound response fixture is the inline JSON body in TestOutboundTransformer_TransformResponse case 'valid response' (id 'msg_123', text 'Hello! How can I help you?', stop_reason 'end_turn', usage input 10 / output 20). The inbound response test then asserts the inbound-transformed body has id 'msg_123', type 'message', role 'assistant', model 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229', one text content block, stop_reason 'end_turn'. selected_channel is null (no llm.Channel in unit tests); upstream_http is null (no real upstream round-trip in unit tests).

inbound_http._comment: Verbatim copy of conduit/llm/transformer/anthropic/testdata/anthropic-simple-inbound.request.json (used by the inbound integration test 'simple text request transformation'). Model claude-3-sonnet-20240229, max_tokens 1024, temperature 0.7, stop_sequences ['Human:','Assistant:'], one user message with text 'Hello, Claude! How are you today?'. The Anthropic inbound test does not set a URL on httpclient.Request (only Headers+Body), so url is omitted.

content.text: Hello, Claude! How are you today?

unified_request._comment: Expected llm.Request asserted by the Go inbound test (case 'valid simple text request') plus the integration test 'simple text request transformation': Model, MaxTokens=1024, Temperature=0.7, Stop.MultipleStop=['Human:','Assistant:'], one user message whose Content.Content points to 'Hello, Claude! How are you today?'.

content.content: Hello, Claude! How are you today?

outbound_http._comment: From outbound_test.go TestOutboundTransformer_TransformRequest case 'valid simple request' with NewOutboundTransformer('https://api.anthropic.com', 'test-api-key'). Go asserts method=POST, url='https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', Content-Type='application/json', Anthropic-Version='2023-06-01', Auth.Type='api_key', Auth.APIKey='test-api-key'. The body is the Anthropic-shaped MessageRequest produced by marshaling the converted request; its asserted fields (Model, MaxTokens>0) match the unified_request values above. Body_json fields not directly asserted in the Go test are marked 'pending source snapshot'.

body_json._comment: Only fields explicitly asserted by the Go outbound test are populated here. Other MessageRequest fields (system, tools, tool_choice, etc.) are not asserted for this case and are omitted rather than synthesized.

messages.content: Hello, Claude! How are you today?

client_http._comment: Assembled from two Go fixtures. (a) outbound_test.go TestOutboundTransformer_TransformResponse case 'valid response' provides the upstream httpclient.Response body (id 'msg_123', type 'message', role 'assistant', one text content 'Hello! How can I help you?', model 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229', stop_reason 'end_turn', usage input 10 / output 20). (b) inbound_test.go TestInboundTransformer_TransformResponse case 'valid response' asserts the inbound transformer produces StatusCode=200, Content-Type='application/json', body unmarshals to Message with id 'msg_123', type 'message', role 'assistant', model 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229', exactly one text content block whose text is 'Hello! How can I help you?', and stop_reason 'end_turn'. created=1234567890 is the literal value from the Go inbound-test fixture (the outbound 'valid response' fixture has no created field).
